description:
Signs in an existing email account with email and password and starts a player session (accessToken).
Use when: a registered, verified player logs in, before any tool that needs sessionToken (submit score, cloud save, gift code redeem, profile, validated runs).
Not for: guest accounts (use horizon_signin_anonymous), new players (use horizon_signup_email) or checking an existing token (use horizon_check_auth).
Side effects: creates a new session on every call; older sessions stay valid.
Returns: {userId, username, email, accessToken, authStatus, message}, with refreshToken and both expiry timestamps only when explicitly opted in. Pass accessToken as sessionToken. Access sessions have a one-hour sliding lifetime; refresh tokens rotate and expire after 30 days.
Errors: 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS for wrong credentials. 403 USER_NOT_VERIFIED requires horizon_verify_email first. Use horizon_forgot_password only when the player requests recovery. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

email.description: Email address the account was registered with (max 40 characters)

includeRefreshToken.description: Explicit opt-in to a rotating 30-day refresh session; omitted or false preserves access-only behavior. Store refresh tokens in platform secure storage

password.description: Account password (max 128 characters); sent to the API only, never returned

name: horizon_signin_email
title: Sign In with Email
